speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To better understand your symptoms, can you describe the location and severity of your abdominal pain, and have you noticed any changes in your bowel habits or appetite recently?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have a history of tuberculosis or recent travel to an area where it is common? Also, have you noticed any pain in your joints or back, and is the enlarged lymph node tender to the touch?

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Doctor
text: The fixed, non-tender supraclavicular lymph node combined with your 'B symptoms' is highly concerning for malignancy. REQUEST TEST: CT scan of chest, abdomen, and pelvis.
